title: Skills
description: The skill graph. Each entry is one skill; requires links it to the skills you learn first. Entries are grouped by style in the file.

id.description: Stable short id. Practice logs refer to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

style.description: Which style it belongs to: foundations, cruising (cruising & fitness), park, street, dance (dance & artistic), slalom (slalom & freestyle), or off-skate (drills done without skates).

requires.description: Skill ids to be comfortable with first. [] for a starting point.

supports.description: For off-skate drills: the skill ids this drill helps with.

skates.description: Skate setup it needs: inline or quad skates, a heel brake, toe stops, or a grind-ready setup. Leave out if any skates work.

needs.description: Spot features it needs. Each inner list is a choice: any one of them will do, e.g. [["ledge", "rail"]] means a ledge or a rail.

surfaces.description: Only suggest it at these surfaces. Leave out for anywhere.

smoothGround.description: true if it shouldn't be suggested on rough ground.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the skill is.

cues.description: Short practice cues, most important first.
